zoning: Use case: infographic-diagram. Create a beautiful, credible Canadian small-town zoning and road concept map for fictional Two River Forest, planning capacity 500 detached houses. Landscape 3:2 canvas, strict orthographic overhead map, no perspective. Two narrow winding rivers through forest corridors at west and east sides, connected below the town by a wooded confluence. Town between the rivers. Central north-south Main Street with a compact coral commercial strip, one pink school campus and one small pink church campus near the centre. An industrial district in blue near the southeast bypass with separate truck access. Residential zoning pale yellow: roughly ten distinct irregular neighbourhood blocks, interconnected winding local streets and crescent roads branching from a connected hierarchy of main street and two gently curving cross-town collectors; varied street geometry, no huge rectangular grid and no repeated cloned loops. Deep green protected riparian forest, pale green parks and green fingers breaking up housing, tan agricultural fields outside. Roads have clean readable gray pavement and thin ivory edges, broad collectors and narrower local streets. Fine schematic parcel divisions in residential areas suggest capacity, but do not draw individual buildings, roofs, solar panels, or pools in this zoning stage. Entire town visible, generous surrounding landscape. Restrained municipal zoning map craft, Whitby Ontario zoning map inspiration, high clarity. No labels, no text, no legend, no decorative icons. This is a conceptual layout proposal, not a count-certified parcel map.
fullIllustration: Use case: sketch-to-render. Edit this complete, measured map into a richly detailed orthographic 2.5D Canadian town illustration. Two River Forest: 451 residential houses (approved nominal 500 with 10% tolerance), 100 backyard pools, ZERO solar panels, one school (large pink site left of central main street), one church (pink site right of it), 16 small main street commercial buildings (coral parcels), six southeast industrial buildings (blue parcels) and one small water works. STRICT REGISTERED MAP: keep identical 3:2 canvas, river curves, forest bands, road positions/widths, parcel/property boundaries, ALL existing building footprints, orientations and existing pool coordinates. DO NOT redesign, shift roads, add houses or buildings, duplicate rooftops, enlarge houses beyond their source footprints, invent pools, or create solar panels. Gray/brown rectangles are buildings: each exactly one building, add subtle shingles, shallow wall/eave relief and architectural distinction within its footprint; shops brick flat-roof storefronts, school institutional brick building, church gabled roof with tiny steeple, industrial metal roofs. Every cyan rectangle is a pool; retain exactly at those locations and sizes. Green unbuilt land remains unbuilt: gardens, parks, meadow and forest, no added property footprints. Agricultural outskirts stay fields without new buildings. Add natural forest canopy detail, fences and hedges on existing property lines, garden beds, driveways exactly connecting houses to their existing roads, small trees and rich land textures. Soft sunlight upper left, tasteful realistic architectural illustration like a high-end aerial town atlas. Strict overhead orthographic camera, shallow 2.5D material relief only, no perspective. Maximum detail/resolution, preferably 3072x2048. No labels, words, frame, legend or UI. This is a registered texture trial; preserve geometry above all decoration.
